Jharkhand Development : jharkhand men parv-tyoharon ke bad ab vikas karyon ko lekar sarkar ne apni taiyari tej karne ka dava kiya hai. sarkar ka lakshy march tak vikas se jure nirdharit lakshyon ko pura karna hai. iske lie vikas karyon ki samiksha aur yojnaon ko gati dene par jor diya ja raha hai.
Lekin is bich saval uth raha hai ki jharkhand men vikas ka rodmaip taiyar ho raha hai ya sirph branding par jor diya ja raha hai? sarkar ke vikas ke davon aur jamini hakikat ke bich kitni duri hai? march tak tay kie gae lakshy kitne pure ho paenge? dekhie is riport men.
